title: 2026 年云计算结构性变革：AI‑Ops、Agentic AI 与安全合规的多云新格局
core_insight: 全球主要云厂商同步推出 AI‑Ops 与 Agentic 计算平台并强化安全合规，标志着云计算向以智能体驱动的自动化运维和主权安全为核心的结构性升级。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 推出 Amazon ECS Gateway 与 Lambda Web Functions，强化 Serverless 与容器统一入口；Google Cloud 发布 Agent Compute Engine，提供面向自主智能体的计算基座并在 GKE Inference Gateway 实现批量推理性能提升4倍；Azure 发布面向下一代 AI 的云原生基础设施，深化容器、Serverless 与 AI 推理的集成。 AWS S3 Tables 完全兼容 Apache Iceberg V3，提升大数据湖能力；Google Cloud 将 BigQuery ObjectRef 推至 GA，实现 SQL 层多模态数据处理并推出 Confidential G4 GPU 以硬件级安全；Azure 开源 Integrated HSM 并通过 Cloudflare 引入后量子 GeoKey Manager，提升硬件安全与抗量子能力。 AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI, Q3 service availability updates, Kiro workflows, and more (October 5, 2026) Inside Agent Compute Engine: Building the compute foundation for the agentic era Introducing Agent Compute Engine and expanded agent governance BigQuery ObjectRef now GA: Build multimodal data platforms for conversational analytics entirely in SQL Hardware-backed security at global scale: Confidential G4 with NVIDIA Blackwell is GA Evolving the cloud-native foundation for the next generation of AI Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
